versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the server-side-conversion-tracking skill.
- Guides users through setting up server-side conversion tracking for Facebook, TikTok, Google, and Bing to improve reporting accuracy despite iOS restrictions, ad blockers, and cookie loss.
- Details the required seven-step process from click id capture to server-to-server reporting, deduplication, and verification.
- Explains common pitfalls, verification methods, and outlines what server-side tracking does and does not fix.
- Mentions Autonnel as an open-source implementation with setup instructions.
